subject.title: feat(memory): add opt-in Nephesh dream provenance

question: Should bundled memory-core own a Nephesh-specific config key and `DREAMS.md` envelope, or should Nephesh consume the existing Dream Diary file through an owner-maintained external integration?
rationale: This chooses a long-lived public configuration and file-format ownership boundary; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want a generic provenance API or no core change at all.

options.title: Externalize Nephesh ingestion
options.body: Have Nephesh or a ClawHub package parse Dream Diary output and assign its own ingestion metadata, leaving bundled memory-core service-neutral.

options.title: Approve a generic provenance contract
options.body: Sponsor a follow-up that defines a service-neutral Dream Diary metadata extension with its ownership, compatibility contract, and upgrade behavior documented before adding a Nephesh consumer.

recommendation.title: Externalize Nephesh ingestion
recommendation.body: Have Nephesh or a ClawHub package parse Dream Diary output and assign its own ingestion metadata, leaving bundled memory-core service-neutral.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the bundled memory plugin’s configuration and Dream Diary output boundary.
